Meet your intelligent shopping companion

Deal Mate is your smart shopping companion designed to help you make confident buying decisions and never overpay. Instead of comparing prices across multiple apps and stores, it gives you instant clarity at the moment of purchase.

Whether you're in a supermarket, shopping online, or exploring a new city, Deal Mate helps you instantly know if a price is fair, find better nearby deals, and discover relevant discounts on what you actually want. By combining real-time price intelligence, personalized recommendations, and location-aware insights, it transforms everyday shopping into a smarter, faster experience.

Deal Mate reduces hesitation, saves time, and maximizes value—empowering you to shop with confidence and make better decisions every time you spend.
